purpose: Teach: 宮内/市況/愛さ/べし/つた/こく/まぜ/混ざっ

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: お味の濃くなった煮物、お客様に伝った、絶対お気に入りです。警察、宮内警備にも携わっております
lines.en: The Imperial Palace security division works closely with us. It's something we take pride in.
lines.style: Steady, measured delivery. Professional warmth without informality. Slight pause before the second sentence, letting the pride settle naturally into the words.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察は市況不安への対応もご準備ですね
lines.en: Yes. I understand the police are also preparing for any market disruptions.
lines.style: Attentive nod in the voice. Measured, respectful. Following his lead without rushing. Soft confirmation on 'Yes' — listening more than speaking.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察は市民を愛さねばならぬ職務です
lines.en: Protecting citizens isn't just a job—it's a responsibility we don't take lightly.
lines.style: Quiet gravity. Not lecturing, but firm. The weight of duty sits naturally in the phrasing. Steady eye contact in the delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察に協力するべしの市民意識、ありがたいです
lines.en: That's why citizen cooperation means so much to us. We're grateful for that trust.
lines.style: Warm sincerity beneath the formality. A small pause before 'grateful'—he means it. Not rushing the words. Quiet emphasis on 'trust.'

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、伝統を継ぐべし、と語り継いでおります
lines.en: We pass down the tradition to the next generation. That continuity matters to us.
lines.style: Reflective tone. Speaking about something that carries weight across time. Slight pause mid-thought, like turning something over carefully in his mind.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、安全を守るべく日夜働いておられます
lines.en: That's why officers work around the clock—to keep people safe. It's a commitment they honour every day.
lines.style: Respectful admiration in the voice. Not deferential, but honoring the work he's describing. Steady pace, warm undertone.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、別班合同でまぜて情報共有します
lines.en: When we work with other divisions, we share information carefully. It has to be secure.
lines.style: Practical efficiency. A hint of caution on 'carefully'—he knows what's at stake. Professional, not cold. Brief pause before the last phrase.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。容疑者の指紋が混ざった現場、警察、慎重ですね
lines.en: Yes. I can see why—when evidence could be contaminated, you have to move cautiously. That precision is important.
lines.style: Understands the weight. Quiet, attentive. Slight lean-in in the delivery—he's not just acknowledging, he's seeing the complexity. Measured respect.
